what_happened: Scene: layout 4, black single-pair toaster (same kitchen as s17), bread in the right slot. Stage 0: the fingers closed at ~190 and stayed closed for the rest of the episode. The first push 336-400 took the lever to 0.77 (bread -4.2 cm), short of the 0.9 needed to switch on, and the lever sprang back up (416-512). A second push at 560-592 reached 1.0 and the toaster was on 582-1081. The lever rose 1088-1264 and stage 0 completed at 1239 (online 1248). Stage 1: while the bread was rising (1080-1180) the arm was already raised to the right, looking down at the toaster. From ~1220 the base turned and drove away from the toaster (1260-1560, facing walls in transit). At ~1560-1580 it was next to the dining counter with the plate in view, with closed, empty fingers. It then turned back toward the kitchen and wandered (1620-2000). It never touched the bread, which stayed in the toaster.
causal_chain: partial lever push (0.77) at 400 -> second push at 592 switched it on -> pop-up done 1239 -> without reaching into the slot, the robot drove off toward the dining counter (1220-1580) empty-handed with closed fingers -> turned away and wandered until timeout -> bread still in the toaster
self_recovery: Stage 0: the policy re-pushed the lever after the insufficient first push (592), which worked. Stage 1: none.
